description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - The meeting to elect a new Chairman to fill Vacant Post of Chairman of the Ella Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting to elect a new Chairman for the Ella Pradeshiya Sabha, which is an electoral process matter under the Local Government Elections Ordinance. It falls under Type 7 (Elections) as it specifically deals with filling a vacant elected position in local government.
